elements_selected.content: Implement UnknownPredecessorPolicy enum {Reject, Buffer{max_pending, ttl}}. Implement apply_policy() that maps VerificationResult + Policy -> PolicyOutcome {Accept, Reject, Pending, Buffered}. For Buffer: PendingQueue with per-thread bounded queue (max_pending default 64, NFR-301), TTL expiry, re-evaluation on store growth. REQ-305. Reject policy preserves zero mutable state (NFR-204, NFR-302).
